_comment: Per-seat API keys. Copy to api_keys.json — the real file is gitignored
because the secrets are bearer tokens.
Do not edit by hand in production. Use the CLI:
Roles: member (read + submit signed deltas), admin (member + manage
keys/trust), viewer (read-only). A revoked key is kept, not deleted,
so the audit log still resolves who past actions belonged to.
